entries.condition: still_grid.png vs reference_a.png and reference_a.json, camera pos (430,392,3660) fov 42, 14:35

entries.defect: Camera is roughly 1.7x too close to both island and aircraft, the causeway and its arch are pushed to the right edge, the aircraft points toward the camera instead of away to the upper-left, and the sunny blue sky is replaced by overcast.
entries.fix: Move the aerial-a camera back/up so the island occupies ~5% of frame and the wing ~13% of width, rotate the aircraft to heading away upper-left with 8-10 deg left bank, place the bridge start near (0.40,0.48) with the arch at mid-span, and set a clear-sky cumulus weather preset for this view.

entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png, front-above-left view of the aircraft
entries.evidence: The outline reads as a stubby high-wing floatplane: a bulbous short fuselage ending in a flat grey nose disc, a thin fin poking above the wing centre, no visible horizontal stabiliser, two capsule floats.
entries.defect: Fuselage length-to-wingspan ratio is far shorter than the reference Beaver, the nose is a flat disc rather than a cowling with propeller, and the tailplane is absent from the silhouette.
entries.fix: Lengthen the rear fuselage and taper it into a proper empennage with a horizontal stabiliser, model a cowling with spinner and prop disc, and match the reference proportions (fuselage ~0.65 of wingspan).

entries.evidence: Wing is a single thin slab with yellow leading/trailing strips, struts are 1-px lines from floats to wing, floats are plain capsules with black cylinders at the ends, the fuselage is a smooth bulb with one tiny yellow rectangle for a door and a flat disc nose.
entries.defect: No cowling, exhaust, wing struts of real thickness, ailerons/flaps, float spreader bars, water rudders or door/window cutouts; the fin merges into the fuselage without a tail cone.
entries.fix: Rebuild the aircraft with a reference-matched mesh: cowling and prop, tapered tail cone, control-surface splits, strut cylinders of 40-60 mm scale, float steps and spreader bars.

entries.condition: yellow-pixel bbox measured on still.png vs reference_a.json aircraft.widthFraction
entries.evidence: Measured wing bbox x 0.691-0.922 (width 0.231, centroid ~0.795,0.755) vs reference width 0.1325 and centroid (0.813,0.752); relative to island trees the wingspan covers ~5-6 canopies which is plausible.

entries.fix: Increase camera-to-aircraft distance for this view (or reduce the aircraft offset) until the wingspan covers ~13% of frame width.

entries.evidence: Navy fuselage shows one broad soft top-to-bottom gradient and no specular lobe; wing, fin, floats and struts all show the same matte response; float yellow measures (189,165,62) vs reference (239,199,90).
entries.defect: Uniform roughness across the whole airframe with no clearcoat highlight, panel lines, rivets, weathering or metal/paint distinction.
entries.fix: Assign PBR materials per part (painted aluminium roughness ~0.3 with clearcoat, matte float tops, metallic struts), add a panel-line/decal albedo and a light AO map.

entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png, cabin roof/windshield panels at the wing root
entries.evidence: Two light-blue rectangles with a vertical gradient sit at the wing root; nothing of the cabin interior, frame thickness or sky reflection is visible.
entries.defect: Glass reads as an opaque painted panel with no transmission, no frame and no environment reflection.
entries.fix: Use a transmissive glass material (transmission ~0.9, roughness 0.05, IOR 1.5) with an environment map, model window frames, and add a simple cabin interior behind the glass.

entries.evidence: Left cluster has plausible massing and a few spire tops but every facade is a single flat pastel colour; the right city at G3-H3 is a row of saturated pastel boxes with no roof detail, no window texture and hard box edges.

entries.fix: Add window-grid and facade material variation per building, rooftop detail meshes, and a street grid at the base; desaturate the right city to match its distance haze.

entries.condition: crops/environment.png and 4x zoom of the shoreline at F7
entries.evidence: The island is a perfectly flat lime-green disc with grey blotches, a constant-width white rim around the whole coast and around the lagoon, and stair-stepped pixel edges on every shoreline mask; no sandbars, dunes, mangrove fringe or relief.
entries.defect: Uniform white beach/foam ring of constant width around every island and the lagoon, plus aliased stair-step shoreline masks.
entries.fix: Drive beach width from a noise-modulated distance field, add a mangrove fringe and shallow sand shelves of varying width, bilinear-filter or SDF the shoreline mask, and add low relief to the terrain.

entries.condition: still.png colour samples vs reference dominantColors
entries.evidence: Near water (37,147,179) saturation 0.79 vs reference (80,148,171) saturation 0.53; far water (125,180,206) vs (118,153,185); the foreground at A7-D8 is a flat cyan with sparse whitish noise smudges and no wave normal detail; a straight darker channel band crosses the bay D3-H4.
entries.defect: Water reads as a flat saturated cyan plane with noise foam; depth shading is limited to a thin lighter shore band and one straight channel stripe.
entries.fix: Add a wave normal map with distance fading, depth-driven absorption/scatter using a real bathymetry texture (irregular shelves and channels), and lower near-water saturation to ~0.55.

entries.evidence: No reflection of sky, clouds, aircraft, bridge or skyline appears anywhere on the water; the water is saturated cyan beneath a grey (181,193,205) sky, which is physically inconsistent.

entries.fix: Add screen-space or planar reflections blended by Fresnel with the sky/environment map so the water picks up sky tone and object reflections.

entries.condition: crops/medium.png and contrast-enhanced zoom of D3-H4

entries.fix: Add a wake system (V-shaped foam trail with fading turbulence texture) per moving boat, add 3-5 moving boats near the camera, and shoreline wave breaks driven by depth.

entries.condition: 4x zoom of trees at F7 and crops/environment.png

entries.condition: 2x zoom of the causeway on still.png
entries.evidence: The deck is an 8-10 px light-grey ribbon lying directly on the water with tiny car specks; no piers, no deck thickness, no shadow on the water, and the arch/cable pylon is a cluster of thin lines at the far end (0.90,0.33).

entries.evidence: Sky is a flat grey-white gradient with soft smudge blobs (E1-H1, A2-D2) and no lit tops, shaded bases or cloud shadows; reference has two cumulus banks covering 39% above the horizon with crisp edges.
entries.defect: Clouds are a 2D noise smear with no volume, lighting or shadowing.

entries.evidence: Haze increases with distance and the far skyline is progressively washed, but it is neutral grey rather than blue and the far terrain band at A3-H3 stays mint-green while the buildings beside it are washed white.
entries.defect: Fog is too dense and colourless and is applied inconsistently between terrain and buildings.
entries.fix: Use a height/distance fog with a blue in-scatter colour derived from the sky, reduce density by ~40%, and apply the same fog function to terrain and buildings.

entries.condition: still.png at HUD time 14:35, reference sun high from behind-left

entries.fix: Set a directional sun for 14:35 (elevation ~50 deg, from behind-left), enable cascaded shadow maps, lower exposure by ~0.5 EV and add sun glint on the water.

entries.condition: 4x zoom under trees and houses at F7/E5

entries.evidence: Water has no specular highlight or glint; the airframe shows no highlight beyond a soft top gradient; glass panels show a gradient but no reflected environment.
entries.defect: Specular response is missing on water, paint and glass.

entries.condition: region means on still.png vs reference dominantColors

entries.condition: still.png, aircraft a few metres above a calm sea at 13:00
entries.evidence: The sea directly under the floats shows no reflection of the aircraft, sky or horizon; it is a smooth cyan gradient.
entries.defect: Reflections absent where a mirror-calm sea would show them most strongly.
entries.fix: Add planar reflections for the aircraft and sky with Fresnel and wave distortion.

entries.condition: still.png (approach, THR 25%); flight metrics onWater true with 189 points
entries.evidence: No ripples, wind streaks, spray or wake exist around the floats in the still; the flight metrics indicate a spray particle system exists once on water but it is not visible here.
entries.defect: No water surface interaction visible on approach.
entries.fix: Add wind ripples and float downwash disturbance on approach, and spray/wake decals at touchdown.

entries.evidence: No sun glint on the calm sea and no highlight on the paint despite a near-zenith sun.
entries.defect: Specular response missing.
entries.fix: Add sun specular to the water and clearcoat paint highlights.

entries.evidence: The sea is empty of boats, buoys, channel markers or birds; the shore is a uniform treeline with no buildings.
entries.defect: Empty world around the landing area.
entries.fix: Add channel buoys, a few boats, a dock and waterfront buildings near the landing lane.

entries.condition: 2x zoom of the water beneath the floats at D8-F8
entries.evidence: At 2-10 m altitude the water shows no wave normals, chop or transparency, only a smooth cyan gradient with faint horizontal banding.
entries.defect: Water reads as a flat blue plane at touchdown distance.
entries.fix: Add multi-octave wave normals and small chop near the camera plus depth-based transparency.

entries.condition: metrics.json still vs flight: still planeCentroid (0.5,0.57), flight planeCentroid (1.97,0.74), onWater true, airspeed 17.9 m/s
entries.evidence: The chase camera yaws ~70 deg during the 3 s touchdown and the aircraft leaves the frame to the right.
entries.defect: Chase camera loses the aircraft during the landing.
entries.fix: Clamp chase-camera yaw rate and keep the aircraft within a screen-space deadzone during on-water transitions.

entries.evidence: Wing, stabiliser, fin, floats and fuselage share one matte response; the navy paint shows a soft gradient without a highlight.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness across the airframe.
entries.fix: Per-part PBR materials with clearcoat paint.

entries.evidence: The roof glass is a dark navy rectangle bounded by red/white trim with no transparency or reflection.
entries.defect: Glass renders opaque.
entries.fix: Transmissive glass with an interior and environment reflection.

worst3: Sea within metres of the floats is a flat cyan gradient with no waves, spray or reflection of the aircraft (A6-H8)

entries.condition: still.png at 18:45, bright pink sky and lit city above a calm bay

entries.defect: Reflections absent at the lighting condition where they dominate the reference look.

entries.evidence: No specular sheen on the water and no rim light on the wing, floats or fin despite a bright sky behind and above the aircraft.
entries.defect: Specular response missing on water and airframe.
entries.fix: Add sky-environment specular to water and paint materials.

entries.evidence: No boat lights, wakes or water traffic are visible.
entries.defect: Water traffic absent.

entries.evidence: The upper wing surface faces a bright pink sky yet renders black; paint shows no response to the environment.
entries.defect: Materials ignore sky irradiance and reflection.
entries.fix: Use an environment map for diffuse and specular IBL on the aircraft materials.

entries.evidence: No cockpit glass or instrument glow is visible; the cabin is a black shape.
entries.defect: Glass has no reflection and the cockpit has no interior lighting at dusk.
entries.fix: Add glass reflection and an emissive instrument-panel glow visible through the windows.

entries.evidence: Water is a near-black grainy plane with no colour, depth cue or reflection.
entries.defect: Water reads as a flat dark plane.
entries.fix: Reflect sky and lights on the water and add wave detail lit by the sky.

entries.evidence: No sun disc, no warm horizon glow direction and no key light; the sky is a symmetric pink-purple gradient and 22.8% of pixels are below luma 16.
entries.defect: Sunset without a sun and with crushed exposure.
entries.fix: Place a low sun with warm directional light and horizon glow toward it, and raise the exposure floor for the foreground.

entries.defect: Reflections absent; water colour ignores the sky.

entries.evidence: No boats or wakes; the only white on the water is uniform noise foam.

entries.evidence: No broad soft sheen on the water and no highlight on the paint; overcast light should still produce a wide specular band.

entries.evidence: Islands, a thin grey pier at C5 and the aircraft are the only objects; no boats, houses, cars or birds.

entries.fix: Add boats, small settlements, docks and birds.

entries.condition: 2x zoom of the foam at A7-D8 and the shallow band at C5-D6

entries.evidence: The sky is a uniform grey field with faint smudges; no cloud-base structure, brightness variation or breaks.
entries.defect: Overcast reads as a flat background colour rather than a cloud layer.

entries.evidence: Grey sky over saturated cyan water and bright green foliage; overcast light should desaturate and cool the ground.
entries.defect: Ground and water saturation inconsistent with overcast illumination.
entries.fix: Drive water and ground tint from the sky irradiance so overcast desaturates the scene.

entries.evidence: Islands are flat discs of tree blobs on grey mud with a constant-width white rim and stair-stepped shoreline pixels.
